messages:
alex.m: Heads-up — we're kicking off a rebuilt base image to fix multiple CVEs and migrate signing to KMS-wrapped keys. Need agreement on ephemeral RBAC for CI runners and audit logging changes. :warning:

kim: What's the plan for key material? Are we moving from local GPG to KMS asymmetric signing?

alex.m: Yes — private key will live in cloud KMS, using an asymmetric signing key (RSA-PSS or ECDSA depending on provider). CI will call a signing proxy with a short-lived token. We need transient role to allow `image-builder` service account to call `kms.sign` for the duration of the build.

jordan: Right — propose one-hour ephemeral grants via STS scoped to the build ID. Post-build revoke or let expire. Audit logs must record build_id, image_digest, key_version, principal, and build_artifact_uri.

security-bot: Automated note: Ensure AuditConfig has 'dataAccess' and 'adminRead' enabled for KMS and Container Registry APIs. Also enable key rotation logging and BigQuery export for alerts.

alex.m: Question for infra: can we enforce that the signing proxy writes immutable audit records to a WORM-compatible bucket and pushes an attestation blob (in-toto style) alongside the image manifest? Example signing call:

```
curl -X POST https://sign-proxy.internal/sign \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SHORT_LIVED_TOKEN" \
  -F "build_id=$BUILD_ID" \
  -F "digest=$IMAGE_DIGEST" \
  -F "signature=@sig.bin"
```

ops-oncall: We can set bucket retention/lifecycle to make deletes impossible for a period and replicate to a locked project. Cross-cloud WORM has caveats; for multi-region we'll replicate logs to a locked account and restrict IAM (no delete role). Also we can add an alert if a build uses non-approved base layers (compare SBOM layer digests).

kim: For vuln triage: proposal — critical/high CVEs discovered during or after build block rollout and open an incident; medium/low are recorded, scheduled for patch, and can proceed through canary with increased monitoring. Add an automated SBOM CVE scan step pre-signing.

alex.m: I'll draft the ephemeral RBAC policy and the signing-proxy flow (STS token exchange + short TTL). Jordan, can you draft the audit log schema (fields and retention)?

jordan: On it — I'll post a schema with examples by EOD. Also will add sample BigQuery table layout for queries and alerting.

kim: LGTM :thumbsup:

jordan: I/O: have a follow-up doc link: https://internal/redwood/secure-builds (draft).
